title: Cherchez la Femme and the Fugu Fish

scenes.title: Look for the Woman in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: Max reflects on how women drive every twist in a man's life while Kristina flirts in the kitchen and Nagiyev jealously orders Chef Barinov to keep the cooks away from her.

scenes.title: The Kind Chef and a Talk at the Bar
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov surprises everyone by praising the dishes instead of yelling, while Sasha and Kristina chat at the bar about men and Max.

scenes.title: A Suspiciously Kind Chef
scenes.summary: The cooks gather to figure out why Chef Barinov is acting so unusually gentle and sober this morning, suspecting a secret diagnosis or crisis.

scenes.title: Dorado for Sasha
scenes.summary: Max finishes observing the Chef's strange behavior and invites Sasha into the kitchen to taste the special dorado he cooked for her.

scenes.title: Elena Pavlovna's Secret Admirer
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov calls Elena Pavlovna pretending to be a mysterious scuba diver admirer and furiously chases Max away when interrupted.

scenes.title: A Secret Order from Timur
scenes.summary: The cooks decide to spy on Chef Barinov, who meets supplier Timur by the cold storage room to demand an exotic and dangerous ingredient right away.

scenes.title: The Secret Delivery for the Chef
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov pressures Timur to deliver the fresh exotic fish immediately without telling a soul, while the cooks interrogate Timur about what the Chef ordered.

scenes.title: The Farewell Note and the Dish
scenes.summary: Max sneaks into the Chef's office under the pretext of asking about a raise and spots the poetic noteChef Barinov wrote to accompany his fugu dish for Elena.

scenes.title: Elena's Call and the Cooks' Panic
scenes.summary: Elena calls Viktor Petrovich to thank him for the delicious dish and arrange a meeting in an hour, while the cooks panic after realizing the Chef tasted the fugu himself.

scenes.title: The Chef Locked in the Walk-in Fridge
scenes.summary: To keep the supposedly poisoned Chef from driving off, Fedya and Senya lock Viktor Petrovich inside the walk-in refrigerator with a crate of cognac.

scenes.title: The Locked-Up Chef's Rampage
scenes.summary: Furious at missing his date with Elena, Chef Barinov pounds on the door and threatens to kill Senya and Fedya while the cooks remain convinced he is delirious.

scenes.title: Kristina's Ultimatum
scenes.summary: In the dining room, Kristina corners Max and threatens to fire him or his friend Kostya over a broken bottle of vintage wine unless Max meets her after work.

scenes.title: The Broken Bottle and Blackmail
scenes.summary: Max confronts Kostya in the kitchen about the shattered bottle of expensive wine and reveals that Kristina is blackmailing him into sleeping with her.

scenes.title: Nastya's Principles and Max's Decision
scenes.summary: Nastya urges Max to reject Kristina's blackmail even if it costs Kostya his job, and Max promises to go talk to Kristina after the shift.

scenes.title: The Drunken Chef Fires Everyone
scenes.summary: After drinking the cognac in the walk-in fridge, Chef Barinov stumbles out, fires Fedya and the entire kitchen staff on the spot, and passes out.

scenes.title: Apologies to the Chef
scenes.summary: Once Chef Barinov wakes up, the cooks confess that they locked him in the fridge because they thought he had poisoned himself with fugu, and Vika steps in to call Elena.

scenes.title: Elena's Call and the Visit to Kristina
scenes.summary: Elena forgives Viktor Petrovich after hearing how worried his cooks were about him, while Max goes to Kristina's office only to hear Nagiyev inside with her.

scenes.title: Reconciling with Nagiyev and Saving Max
scenes.summary: After passionately reconciling with Nagiyev, a cheerful Kristina gives Max a replacement bottle of wine from her personal collection and drops her threat.

scenes.title: An Evening with Sasha and the Philosophy of Women
scenes.summary: Max brings the rare wine home to Sasha while Chef Barinov finally meets Elena Pavlovna, concluding with Max's reflection on everything men do for women.
